USF Health Physical Therapy Program moves into a new home, marking its next chapter
After years of growth and rising demand, the USF Health Morsani College of Medicine School of Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation Sciences (SPTRS) is entering a new chapter, moving into a newly renovated facility on the USF campus that will double its space and strengthen its standing among the nation’s top programs.
Twice as nice: Athletic Training Program repeats as Quiz Bowl national champions
For the second straight year, the USF Health Morsani College of Medicine Athletic Training Program has claimed the top prize at the National Athletic Training Association (NATA) Quiz Bowl, making history as the competition’s first ever back-to-back national champions.
Physical therapy scholarship celebrates beloved Bucs trainer
Tom “Ox” Oxley—kind, humble, and beloved as the Tampa Bay Buccaneers’ head trainer (1977–1984)—continues to inspire future physical therapists. After his passing on May 12, his daughter Elizabeth Oxley, established the Thomas Oxley Memorial Scholarship in Physical Therapy at USF in his honor. In just three weeks, the fund reached its $25,000 endowment goal, ensuring that Oxley’s values—compassion, empathy, and patient-centered care—are passed on to the next generation.
Rising Bull in Medicine: Whitney Herd
Whitney Herd, doctor of physical therapy student, turned her passion for dance and science into a career in physical therapy.
USF Health & St. Pete College PT/PTA Students Team Up for IPE Day to Enhance Patient Care & Teamwork
USF Health and St. Petersburg College students from Physical Therapy (PT) and Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) programs came together for an exciting Interprofessional Education (IPE) Day, focused on improving collaboration, communication, and patient outcomes.
Doctor of Physical Therapy class of 2027 don first white coats
The Doctor of Physical Therapy class of 2025 receives new white coats during their Commitment to the Profession Ceremony.
IPE Day 2024 addresses nutrition, food insecurity, community health
IPE Day 2024 meets Iron Chef. This year's event focuses on how food scarcity and food deserts play a role in community health and long-term patient outcomes.
USF Health officially welcomes newest DPT students
USF Health's newest physical therapy students are officially welcomed to their journey to a career in health care.
USF Health Research Day showcases strong research and collaboration
Another record for USF Health Research Day, the largest research-oriented event of its kind at USF and the largest celebration of health sciences research collaboration.
SPTRS expands services more USF students
The USF Health Physical Therapy Center recently expanded services to the new University of South Florida Student Health and Wellness Center.
Physical Therapy team earns awards at state-wide meeting
The USF Health School of Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation Sciences had a great showing at the recent Florida Physical Therapy Association meeting by earning three of the top awards presented.
